CHAPTER 1 · ITEM 08 / 10

Interaction, markets and government

Markets, prices & property市場、價格與產權

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Define a market, market economy, property rights, and the “invisible hand”; explain how prices coordinate buyers' and sellers' choices.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

市場是買家與賣家的集合；市場經濟靠分散決策及價格協調資源。產權保障擁有和交易權利，價格傳遞稀缺與價值資訊。

A market is a group of buyers and sellers. In a market economy, decentralized choices coordinate through prices. Property rights support ownership and exchange; the invisible hand describes how self-interested choices can coordinate resource allocation under suitable conditions.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Coffee becomes scarce; a higher price encourages conservation and greater supply. Enforceable ownership lets sellers receive payment. 咖啡價格上升同時影響買賣雙方誘因。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Which signal coordinates buyers and sellers in a market economy? 什麼訊號協調市場？
